facts.fact: 美国总统在椭圆形办公室的沙发上说自己时间不多，十五分钟后要见 Bono。
facts.anchor: said the President of the United States of America, seated on a sofa in the Oval Office

facts.fact: 众议院情报委员会主席斯金纳向总统介绍来自兰利的霍华德·巴顿弗莱。
facts.anchor: How ’bout I introduce you to Howard BUTTONFLY from over there at Langley.

facts.fact: BUTTONFLY 说明这是自己 1963 年进中情局时被给的假名，并承认自己有苏格兰-爱尔兰血统。
facts.anchor: Just a pseudonym, a phony made-up name they gave me when I started at the Agency back in ’63.

facts.fact: BUTTONFLY 播放取自站长 ARISTOTLE 圆珠笔内 SD 芯片的录音。
facts.anchor: BUTTONFLY pressed PLAY on the recording taken from the SD microchip that had been in COS ARISTOTLE’s ballpoint pen

facts.fact: 录音里 BLUEBELL 拒绝加强对线人的审查，用蔑称骂约旦人，坚持照常推进。
facts.anchor: The Jords are a bunch a stinkin’ ragheads, of that I have no doubt.

facts.fact: 总统当场批准「希腊岛计划 2.0」，说要在「暗天日」到来前动手。
facts.anchor: I’m pulling the trigger on Project Greek Island 2.0, before the Dark Sky Days come and it’s too late.

facts.fact: 总统签署桌上的秘密行动授权书，复印后分给斯金纳和 BUTTONFLY。
facts.anchor: He signed the Covert Action Finding sitting on his desk.

facts.fact: 两人从白宫厨房离开，访客登记簿上没有留下任何记录。
facts.anchor: No record of their presence appeared in the White House Visitors Log.
